archetypes.name: lint-contract-reviewer
archetypes.rationale: The independent checks, line attribution, and scoped suppressions can interact despite the bounded file set.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the plan against the current lint control flow and required verbatim detectors. Check that v1 and v2 remain independent for missing, scalar, Read-enabled, and Read-less tool declarations. Verify finding messages, line numbers, suppression scope, exit codes, and live-tree coverage. Cite each finding with a repository path and symbol or test name. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
